protocol.timing: hardware[a:b] versus gain*engine[a-1406:b-1406,0]; no further 93-sample shift
protocol.physical_lag: round(93 renderer latency + 44.1 nominal1ms filter attack - .035*44100 physical source decay-start convention) = -1406
protocol.channel: Original mono versus engine left; no stereo downmix, phase fit or output normalization
protocol.fundamental: Fixed nominal equal-tempered original MIDI; no local frequency refinement
protocol.harmonics: Unchanged quadrature/quadratic-ramp fit below20kHz; H2-H8/H1 fixed in every window
protocol.aliases: Inherited residual-Hann NFFT262144; +/-6Hz local maximum; >37.5Hz harmonic exclusion; original LP12 mask
protocol.alias_guard: interior maximum, prominence >=12dB, >=-75dBc; retain all failures and counts
protocol.lp24: Secondary same-window/same-LP12-mask observation; LP24 hardware validity independently retained
protocol.raw_residual: Direct fixed-gain/fixed-phase mean squared error divided by hardware mean square; phase-sensitive diagnostic only
protocol.overlap: Second note91 window overlaps first by882samples/20ms; not independent held-out validation
protocol.recipe_status: original performance MIDI plus reconstructed physical patch; no original SysEx or capture transfer known
